==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I went to the Magic Hero Academy battle room to meet the top student. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Magic Hero Battle Room is a rectangular gray stone room with a bright white shiny tile floor. The center of the floor has a large black ring.)

Her name is Howlette. She is a genius with the power to become a Were-Owl. (Howlette resembles a female, humanoid owl with glowing golden eyes. They have humanoid arms and legs, with wings on their back. They are covered in brown feathers. They wear a form fitting purple robe with a shiny golden trim.)

Disappointed by her lack of physical strength, I used the spell Meta to give her superhuman physical stats. (Meta is a Greek word that stands for beyond. The spell essentially helps to push someone beyond their normal limits. I thought Meta was a Latin word until I looked up after I woke up. This implies that Greek words also work as spells in my dreams, not just Latin.)
